content:
Assigns scanners to a profile by creating an asynchronous bulk operation task.
Note: You can create a scanner profile using the Create profile endpoint.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string <uuid>
The unique identifier (UUID) of the scanner profile to which you want to
assign scanners.
Array of strings <uuid>
A list of unique identifiers (UUIDs) of the scanners that you want to assign
to the specified profile.
